### UMAP
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
data <- read_tsv('source_fig_S3a.tsv')

ggplot(data, aes(x = UMAP_ATAC_1, y = UMAP_ATAC_2, color = celltype_minor))  +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_celltype_minor) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  coord_fixed((max(data$UMAP_ATAC_1) - min(data$UMAP_ATAC_1)) / (max(data$UMAP_ATAC_2) - min(data$UMAP_ATAC_2)))

ggplot(data, aes(x = UMAP_RNA_1, y = UMAP_RNA_2, color = celltype_minor))  +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_celltype_minor) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  coord_fixed((max(data$UMAP_RNA_1) - min(data$UMAP_RNA_1)) / (max(data$UMAP_RNA_2) - min(data$UMAP_RNA_2)))

```

### Fragment sizes and TSS 
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

data <- read_tsv('source_fig_S3b_tss.tsv')
ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = v, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_patient) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 3))) +
  coord_fixed((max(data$x) - min(data$x)) / (max(data$v) - min(data$v)))
  
data <- read_tsv('source_fig_S3b_frag_size.tsv')
ggplot(data, aes(x = fragmentSize, y = fragmentPercent, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_patient) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 3))) +
  coord_fixed((max(data$fragmentSize) - min(data$fragmentSize)) / (max(data$fragmentPercent) - min(data$fragmentPercent)))

```



### Frip
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

pdata <- read_tsv('source_fig_S3c_D1_7196_D2_4059_D3_4325_D4_5665.tsv')
ggplot(pdata, aes(x = patientID, y = frip, fill = patientID)) +   
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.8, scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, fill = 'grey70', alpha = 0.5, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
  ylim(0, 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_patient) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, size = 12, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

```

### TRV gene usage in circ and vmix libraries
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

TRA_data <- read_tsv('source_fig_S3d.tsv')
ratio <- (max(TRA_data$prop_vmix)-min(TRA_data$prop_vmix))/(max(TRA_data$prop_circ)-min(TRA_data$prop_circ))
ggplot(TRA_data, aes(x = prop_vmix, y = prop_circ)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1 , intercept = 0, size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.7, color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = gene), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", n = nrow(TRA_data))) +
  xlab("Proportion in Vmix") +
  ylab("Proportion in Circ") +
  ggtitle("TRA gene usage") +
  coord_fixed(ratio) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = gene),  max.overlaps = 1, box.padding = 0.5)



# for TRB gene
```

### TRV gene usage in TAI and 10X
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=16}

data_a <- read_tsv('source_fig_S3f.tsv')
data_b <- read_tsv('source_fig_S3g.tsv')

plist <- list()
for(pat in c("D2", "D1", "D4", "D3")){
  ppdata <- data_a %>% dplyr::filter(patient_ID == pat) 
  sp <- cor(ppdata$prop_10X, ppdata$prop_TAI, method = "spearman")
  sp <- scales::number(sp, accuracy = 0.01)
  p <- ggplot(ppdata, aes(x = prop_10X, y = prop_TAI)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = TRAV), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.5, color = "blue") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab("TAI") +
    xlab("10X") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = c("black", "black")),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
          aspect.ratio = 1) +
    # coord_equal(ratio) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", nrow(ppdata))) +
    ggtitle(paste0(pat, "_", sp, "_TRA")) +
    xlim(0, 10) +
    ylim(0, 10)
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
  
  ppdata <- data_b %>% dplyr::filter(patient_ID == pat)
  sp <- cor(ppdata$prop_10X, ppdata$prop_TAI, method = "spearman")
  sp <- scales::number(sp, accuracy = 0.01)
  p <- ggplot(ppdata, aes(x = prop_10X, y = prop_TAI)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = TRBV), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.5, color = "blue") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab("TAI") +
    xlab("10X") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = c("black", "black")),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
          aspect.ratio = 1) +
    # coord_equal(ratio) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", nrow(ppdata))) +
    ggtitle(paste0(pat, "_", sp, "_TRB"))  +
    xlim(0, 10) +
    ylim(0, 10)
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 2)

```
